changes.title: Zoo controls
items: In the zoo: a nameplate under every block (its creature, its area, the area's line and its legend's boon), a bar for the block you're in to add or remove creatures at any level, set them calm, wild, happy or angry, and put them to sleep, and a list (J) to jump to any block; a Zoo button in the bedroom

changes.title: Zoo
items: A zoo (add ?zoo to the link): every area as a block on a grid, a row for each biome, smallest creatures on the left, each with its runestone, its legend asleep in its circle and its creatures calm; paths between the blocks with a relic's flask at every crossing, no waves or timer, each area's night sounds

changes.title: Tree mains open
items: Every area now has its own main tree: where two areas grew the same kind, one grows it its own way (wind-bent on the moor and by the streams, stunted on the plains, the mudflat and the bog, snow-laden on the pack ice, hung with moss in the dells and creeks, ancient and hollow in the old woods, coppiced, pollarded or scorched)
